key_points: U.S. Navy awards Raytheon (RTX) a five-year missile deal valued up to $24.4 billion.
RTX secures a $20.7 billion AMRAAM contract under the Arsenal of Freedom initiative.
Recent quarterly results were strong, lifting the full‑year outlook for the defense segment.
Broad defense‑spending uplift creates a favorable backdrop for RTX’s growth trajectory.
Analysts highlight RTX as a top near‑term watchlist candidate among defense stocks.
